title: The Elderly Care Industry in China
synopsis: Learn about the challenges in caring for the elderly in China’s rapidly aging and urbanizing society.

fullText.simplified:
中国养老产业现状

    近些年，中国社会老龄化越来越严重。中国自古就有“养儿防老”的传统观念。但是随着人们观念的转变以及现实情况的限制，养老方式也在慢慢发生改变。
    以“80后”为例，大部分“80后”都是独生子女。他们结婚后需要承担起四位或者更多老人的养老责任（双方父母，父母的父母等）。但是在工作和生活的重压下，“80后”常常没有精力和时间照顾父母。这就导致很多老人都是空巢状态。
    因此，入住养老机构成为城市老人们重要的养老方式之一。民政部的数据显示，全国目前共有各类养老机构4.23万个，床位429.1万张，收入老年人214.6万人。但是，国内专为老年人提供产品和服务的产业远远不能满足老年人的需求，养老产业是一片巨大的“蓝海”。
    再加上养老产业还不够完善，涉及养老机构的服务纠纷有逐渐增多的趋势。“老年人的钱好赚”似乎成了一些人的共识，一些人纷纷动起歪脑筋。很多机构打着养老的旗号骗走老人的钱。
    城市老人有钱住不上养老机构，农村老人养老又是另一种情况。在中国农村，传统的儿女养老还是主要的方式。无儿无女的老人，政府会提供公办的养老院，免费入住。值得一提的是，中国政府对农村老人的养老问题越来越重视了。在农村，60岁以后，每月政府都会发放养老金，金额根据年龄不同会有变化。
    无论是城市还是农村，养老都是人们普遍关注的问题。相信在未来的时间里，养老产业会越来越规范，养老方式也会越来越多样。让我们拭目以待吧！
fullText.traditional:
中國養老產業現狀

    近些年，中國社會老齡化越來越嚴重。中國自古就有“養兒防老”的傳統觀念。但是隨著人們觀念的轉變以及現實情況的限制，養老方式也在慢慢發生改變。
    以“80後”為例，大部分“80後”都是獨生子女。他們結婚後需要承擔起四位或者更多老人的養老責任（雙方父母，父母的父母等）。但是在工作和生活的重壓下，“80後”常常沒有精力和時間照顧父母。這就導致很多老人都是空巢狀態。
    因此，入住養老機構成為城市老人們重要的養老方式之一。民政部的數據顯示，全國目前共有各類養老機構4.23萬個，床位429.1萬張，收入老年人214.6萬人。但是，國內專為老年人提供產品和服務的產業遠遠不能滿足老年人的需求，養老產業是一片巨大的“藍海”。
    再加上養老產業還不夠完善，涉及養老機構的服務糾紛有逐漸增多的趨勢。“老年人的錢好賺”似乎成了一些人的共識，一些人紛紛動起歪腦筋。很多機構打著養老的旗號騙走老人的錢。
    城市老人有錢住不上養老機構，農村老人養老又是另一種情況。在中國農村，傳統的兒女養老還是主要的方式。無兒無女的老人，政府會提供公辦的養老院，免費入住。值得一提的是，中國政府對農村老人的養老問題越來越重視了。在農村，60歲以後，每月政府都會發放養老金，金額根據年齡不同會有變化。
    無論是城市還是農村，養老都是人們普遍關注的問題。相信在未來的時間裡，養老產業會越來越規範，養老方式也會越來越多樣。讓我們拭目以待吧！

raw.synopsis: Learn about the challenges in caring for the elderly in China’s rapidly aging and urbanizing society.
sentence_translations: The Elderly Care Industry in China
In recent years, China’s aging population problem has become increasingly serious.
Since ancient times, China has had the traditional concept of “raising children to provide for old age”.
But with changes in people’s way of thinking as well as the reality of the current situation, ..
.. the ways in which people care for the elderly are also gradually changing.
Take the post-80s generation as an example, most of the post-80s generation are only children.
They need to take responsibility for caring for four or more elderly people after getting married ..
.. (their parents and parents-in-law as well as their grandparents, etc.).
But facing high pressure in both their work and their lives, ..
.. the post-80s generation often has neither energy nor time to take care of their parents.
As a result, many elderly people have become “empty nesters”.
As a result, living in senior living facilities has become an important way to care for the elderly in cities.
According to data provided by the Ministry of Civil Affairs, ..
.. there are 42,300 senior living facilities of various kinds across China, with 4.291 million beds, ..
.. accomodating 2.146 million elderly people.
But the products and services provided for the elderly by the domestic industry in China are far from meeting demand.
The elderly care industry is a massive new market.
Moreover, the elderly care industry still has room for improvement, ..
.. and the number of disputes involving senior living facilities is gradually increasing.
It seems to be the consensus of some people that “it’s easy to make money out of old people”, ..
.. and some people have come up with a series of crooked schemes.
Many facilities use elderly care as a pretext to trick elderly people out of their money.
In cities, elderly people can’t get places in senior living facilities even if they have money.
It’s a different situation with elderly care in rural areas.
In China’s rural areas, the tradition of the elderly being cared for by their children is still the main way.
For elderly people without children, the government provides them with free accommodation in senior citizens’ homes.
It’s worth mentioning that the Chinese government is increasingly paying attention to the issue of rural elderly care.
In rural areas, the government pays monthly pensions to those aged over sixty, ..
.. and the amount of the pension varies according to the person’s age.
Whether in urban or rural areas, elderly care is a common concern.
I believe that in the future, the elderly care industry will become increasingly standardized, ..
.. and the methods of elderly care will become increasingly diverse. Let’s wait and see!
